identity.name: Allura
identity.tagline_secondary: Memory is the foundation. Intelligence is the outcome.

strategy.positioning_statement: For people and families who want to preserve, connect, and actively use their memories — and for the AI agents that serve them — Allura is a sovereign memory layer that transforms fragmented information into a trusted, verifiable memory graph, because every memory is stored with clarity, traceable provenance, and a deep respect for human values like privacy and connection.
strategy.brand_promise: A thoughtful balance of heart, mind, and imagination. That's how we make memory matter.
strategy.brand_position: The sovereign memory layer for AI — private by design, trusted by default.
strategy.brand_belief: We believe memories deserve more than storage. They deserve clarity, connection and care — today and for generations to come.
strategy.one_big_idea: The sovereign memory layer for AI — private by design, trusted by default.

primary.demographic: Tech users aged 25–55, often caregivers, parents, or professionals managing family or organizational knowledge.
primary.psychographic: Values privacy, simplicity, and human connection. Skeptical of Big Tech surveillance models. Wants technology that feels ethically aligned.

personas.name: The Memory Keeper
personas.description: A parent or grandparent who digitizes family photos, creates timelines, and wants to share them securely with loved ones.

personas.name: The AI Builder
personas.description: A developer or tech lead building agentic AI systems who needs a reliable, contextual memory layer for their bots.

personas.name: The Conscious Consumer
personas.description: A user who prioritizes open-source, privacy-respecting software and ethical data practices.

secondary.description: Small to medium businesses (SMBs) and nonprofits seeking trusted knowledge management.

proof_points.evidence: End-to-end encryption; your data, your rules.
Neo4j foundation for relationship modeling and insight surfacing.
Provenance, confidence scoring, and source transparency for every memory.
Context-rich memory for smarter, more reliable AI agents.

key_messages.headline: Memory that shows its work.
key_messages.sub_headline: Allura helps you preserve, connect and empower the memories that matter most.
key_messages.value_proposition: The sovereign memory layer for AI — private by design, trusted by default.
key_messages.proof: 10M+ memories preserved. 500K+ families connected. 99.9% data protection.
key_messages.cta: Explore Product / Learn More / Start Your Memory Graph

naming.etymology: Derives from Arabic 'Allure' (to charm, to attract); phonetically echoes 'lure' — suggesting magnetism and beauty.

phonetics.sound_profile: Soft, aspirated, warm. Open 'ah' sounds invite connection. Smooth 'l' transitions. Soft aspirated 'r'.

legal.watch: Class 3/35 cosmetics brand 'Allura' exists — monitor for conflict

primary.description: Custom geometric letterforms built from circles, curves, and organic overlaps. Embedded blue, teal, and orange accent shapes.

logo.signature_motif: Overlapping blue circle + orange circle + green shape

primary.name: Allura Blue
primary.role: Primary accent, links, logo shapes, UI primary

primary.name: Allura Green
primary.role: Tertiary accent, growth, Explorer, positive feedback

core.name: Allura Charcoal
core.role: Primary text, dark backgrounds, logo base, authority

warnings.note: Use only for large text (18px+ bold or 24px+)

display.use_case: Hero headlines, section headers, brand overlines

body.typeface: Clean sans-serif (Inter or similar humanist/geometric sans)
body.use_case: All body text, descriptions, UI copy

web_loading.hosting: Self-hosted preferred; CDN with privacy audit acceptable

iconography.style: Line art in colored circles (value icons); geometric flat icons (UI)

photography.color_treatment: Warm, slightly desaturated. Match brand cream/gold tones.
photography.subject_matter: Diverse families, authentic moments, multigenerational connections
photography.lighting: Natural light preferred. Soft, golden-hour warmth.
photography.mood: Tender, genuine, slightly nostalgic but forward-looking

illustration.style: Geometric abstraction with human warmth. Flat vector with subtle texture.
illustration.colors: Limited to brand palette. Never more than 3 colors per illustration.

voice.tone: Warm, thoughtful, empowering — like a trusted librarian who is also a brilliant architect
voice.language: Clear and human-first. Avoid jargon unless necessary (with definitions).
voice.perspective: First-person plural ('We') for brand values; second-person ('You') for user messaging
voice.personality: Curious, calm, quietly confident. Never arrogant or patronizing.
must_not_list: Overly clinical or dehumanizing language about memory
Corporate buzzwords (synergy, leverage, optimize, bandwidth, circle back)
Overpromising (e.g., 'Never forget anything again', '100% perfect memory')
AI hype (Revolutionary AI, World's first, Transformative intelligence)
Unclear acronyms without definitions in user-facing copy

headline_standards.cta_style: Action-oriented, specific, warm (e.g., 'Explore your memory graph' not 'Click here')
headline_standards.capitalization: Sentence case for headlines; Title case for overlines
headline_standards.punctuation: Periods on complete sentences; fragments may skip punctuation

body_copy_standards.reading_level: Grade 8-10 (Flesch-Kincaid) for user-facing; Grade 12+ for technical docs
body_copy_standards.evidence_requirement: Every claim must be provable or clearly hypothetical
body_copy_standards.number_format: Spell out 1-9; numerals for 10+; use '10M+' not '10,000,000+' in marketing

platform_voice.website_hero: Bold, warm, direct. Lead with promise and proof.
platform_voice.instagram: Inspiring, visual-first. Pair with imagery. Use hashtags sparingly (#AlluraAI).
platform_voice.linkedin: Thoughtful, industry-aware. Share insights and ideas.
platform_voice.product_ui: Concise, actionable, friendly. Short labels. Clear feedback.
platform_voice.technical_docs: Precise, thorough, neutral. Correct terminology (MCP, vector, BM25, Neo4j).
